visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a robed woman (open circular head exactly 8 above the robe crown; the crown is the nearest body point) reaching to a tall grain sprig with two pairs of branches, as in the reference. A first candidate with a single branch pair and the hand at mid-stalk passed but matched the rejected drawing too closely. Human reference: full_body_ref.png dress figure.
omissions: Demeter's long hair and the robe's drape line are dropped (no room 8 units clear of the head and robe at 48px); the robe is the standard round-topped dress figure.
drawing_plan: Head r5 (14,11); robe r4 crown at (14,24) flaring to hem 6..22 at y=42; arm (18,28)-(36,38); stalk x=36 from 6 to 42; branch pairs at y=16 (reach 6) and y=28 (reach 5).
